briefing: They look solid from far away, but up close they are made of ice and rock, from tiny bits of dust to chunks as big as a house.
Saturn is so light that it would float in a bathtub, if you could find one big enough.
Its moon Titan has lakes, but they are not made of water.
Fly between the rings, not through them.
preflightLine: Rings are pretty. Rings are also rocks. Same rule as always: type it before it reaches us.
warpSentence: Saturn wears rings made of ice and rock.
beaconFlavor: Threaded the rings. The next ship won't have to.
